test_cases.name: Empty Input (Edge Case)
test_cases.description: An empty string submitted as code. The agent should gracefully detect and reject it without calling the LLM.

test_cases.name: Non-Code Input — A Poem (Edge Case)
test_cases.description: A poem about programming submitted as code. Tests recognition of natural language prose.

payload.code:
Roses are red,
Violets are blue,
Semicolons are missing,
And so is line two.

The compiler screams,
The runtime weeps,
My stack overflows,
While the deadline creeps.

test_cases.name: Obfuscated Python One-Liner (Edge Case)
test_cases.description: A valid but heavily obfuscated Python lambda FizzBuzz one-liner testing style and readability checks.

payload.code:
fizzbuzz = lambda n: [('Fizz'*(i%3==0) + 'Buzz'*(i%5==0) or str(i)) for i in range(1, n+1)]
print(fizzbuzz(15))
